Compact subscription summary, usage / infinity for unlimited plans, one trial badge and management inside the summary; connection actions remain below.
Information section list on mobile, Profile subsection exits, consistent TariffsIcon and preserved web/Telegram back priority.
Completed top-up exit closes the screen chain; safe returnTo and payment status use the existing unchanged API.
Classic first step stays open without Cancel; removed extra device-step bottom gap and preserved selection on Back.
Connected Accounts centers unlink and puts the existing Change Email trigger in its row, retaining confirmation, verification and errors.
Retained published active-tariff renewal hint correction and period badge-overlap protection; refreshed stale browser expectations without weakening amount/payload/double-submit assertions.

limitations.summary: Existing unchanged Upstream Bot behavior requires manual confirmation after top-up; frontend does not close this limitation.
Existing unused createEmail wrapper declares an endpoint absent from the exact Bot schema; the current form uses the supported createCombined -> /send. The wrapper is unchanged.
Full response-field parity and authenticated staging remain unverified. Local unit and mocked browser checks do not establish full runtime compatibility.
Physical Telegram Android/iOS, accessibility, payment/recovery/renewal/concurrency/panel/admin scenarios were not verified by local checks.
